emacs--Fortran-Autofill>emacs--ForIndent: Fortran mode has specialized support for Auto Fill mode, which is a minor mode that automatically splits statements as you insert them when they become too wide
emacs--Fortran-Autofill>emacs--Auto-Fill: Fortran mode has specialized support for Auto Fill mode, which is a minor mode that automatically splits statements as you insert them when they become too wide
emacs--Fortran-Autofill>emacs--Hooks: To enable Auto Fill in all Fortran buffers, add auto-fill-mode to fortran-mode-hook. See Hooks.
